findings.location: translation.html paragraph 20 (quotation of 1 Timothy 2:11-13 and commentary)
findings.source_quote: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection. But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence. For Adam was first formed, then Eve –1 Timothy 2:11-13.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider a slightly clearer Indonesian phrasing that preserves the original theological force while remaining literal to the English: e.g. replace "kami percaya agar perempuan berdiam di gereja" with "kami percaya agar perempuan berdiam dalam gereja" or "kami percaya agar perempuan berdiam-diri di dalam ibadah gereja" to reduce potential ambiguity. This is a minor clarity edit; theology and meaning should remain unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Seperti yang Paulus ajarkan, kami percaya agar perempuan berdiam di gereja, tetapi ini tidak berarti perempuan harus diam dalam segala situasi, tempat, dan hubungan.
